During the [[New Republic Era]],<ref name="SC 102" /> a [[Gender|male]]<ref name="SC 102 AD" /> [[human]] '''vomiter''' was a denizen of [[Borgo Prime|Starport Borgo]], an [[asteroid]] infamous for [[pirate]] activity.<ref name="SC 102" />

Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the man was standing by the landing platform with a [[Quarren]], a [[Shydopp]], and three other humans. All of a sudden, the individual retched, bent over, and threw up. As they released a light-[[Color|green]], fluid substance from their mouth, some of their companions began laughing at them. This vomiting incident was witnessed by the [[youngling]]s<ref name="SC 102" /> from the [[Skeleton Crew]],<ref name="T19XifsgFS0">{{SWYouTube|T19XifsgFS0|Skeleton Crew | Blast from the Past | Streaming Dec 2 on Disney+}}</ref> who had only arrived in the [[Spaceport|starport]] in hopes of finding someone to ask for directions [[At Attin|home]].<ref name="SC 102" />

A light-skinned human, the vomiter was dressed in rugged, utilitarian [[Clothing|attire]], with an [[Pilot|aviator]] hat on their head, adorned with a pair of [[goggles]]. When in Starport Borgo, the man carried with them a [[blaster rifle]].<ref name="SC 102" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Port Borgo is so busy from a sound point of view. The kitchen sounds like the kitchen, the animal area is filled with little creatures, and of course, all the pirates getting in a fight, or me getting on mic and offering the sound of me pretending to throw up all over the floor. That was so much fun to record.|Sound editor David W. Collins|audio=CollinsOnPortBorgo.mp3|<ref name="-N11lYPwaS4">{{SWYouTube|-N11lYPwaS4|Star Wars: Skeleton Crew | Behind the Design | Disney+}}</ref>}}
The vomiter first appeared in "[[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier]]," the second episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC 102" /> which premiered on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref> In a promotional video released on [[January 22]], [[2025]], sound editor [[David W. Collins]] revealed that he had voiced the individual himself—a line he found very fun to record by pretending to "throw up all over the floor."<ref name="-N11lYPwaS4" />
